svg.title: What lies on disk: package, run, register and ledger as files
svg.desc: Three columns. The package, written by hand, generated or taken over: a folder with workflow.json, scripts, a container image with its Dockerfile, and catalog.json; an excerpt of workflow.json shows two blocks, one naming the container image. A run, written only by the tool: a folder with events.jsonl, blobs, manifest.json, run.html and scratch; an excerpt of events.jsonl shows three lines, each holding the hash of the line before. Register and ledger: the folder of a register, kept per audit key and project, with its chained log, blobs, state.json and report.html, and the ledger, a git repository whose log holds one commit per start and per end of a run and per head of a register. The first line of a run names the digest of its package, the register names the run that reported each finding, and the ledger names the last line of both.
